text: 温氏股份公告，公司实际控制人之一暨董事长温志芬于2026年10月15日提议公司以自有资金或自筹资金通过集中竞价方式回购A股，资金总额不低于人民币5000万元（含）且不超过人民币1亿元（含），回购价格不高于董事会审议通过回购股份方案决议前30个交易日公司股票交易均价的150%，回购股份用于实施股权激励。董事会将尽快研究并制定回购方案，具体以董事会审议通过的方案为准。
text_en: Wens Foodstuff Group announced that Wen Zhifen, one of the company's actual controllers and chairman, proposed on October 15, 2026 that the company repurchase A-shares through centralized bidding using its own funds or self-raised funds, with the total amount no less than RMB 50 million (inclusive) and no more than RMB 100 million (inclusive), and the repurchase price no higher than 150% of the average trading price of the company's shares in the 30 trading days before the board resolution approving the share repurchase plan. The repurchased shares will be used to implement equity incentives. The board will study and formulate the repurchase plan as soon as possible, subject to the plan approved by the board.
